# zerops_service_deploy (Resource)

An immutable deployment invocation. Destroy only forgets this invocation; it never stops or rolls back the service. Import is unsupported because source inputs cannot be reconstructed. Server Git mode builds branch HEAD at build time, not a pinned commit, and requires a repository zerops.yml.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Invocation inputs are immutable: changing source contents, YAML or triggers
# creates a new app version. Destroy only forgets this invocation, and import
# is unsupported because the remote API cannot recover source/YAML inputs.
resource "zerops_service_deploy" "app" {
  service_id = zerops_service.app.id
  source_dir = "${path.module}/app"
  setup      = "app"
  build      = true

  zerops_yaml = <<-YAML
    zerops:
      - setup: app
        build:
          base: nodejs@22
          buildCommands:
            - echo build
          deployFiles:
            - index.js
        run:
          base: nodejs@22
          ports:
            - port: 3000
              protocol: tcp
              httpSupport: true
          start: node index.js
  YAML

  timeouts {
    create = "30m"
  }
}

# Alternative sources (replace source_dir, never combine sources):
# archive_path = "${path.module}/app.tar.gz"
# git = {
#   url  = "https://github.com/zeropsio/recipe-nodejs"
#   ref  = "4a156a716a3087ea4b4f0b00814b5ea1d3f21590"
#   mode = "provider" # exact commit fetched and archived locally
# }
# For private HTTPS repositories in provider mode, supply ZEROPS_GIT_TOKEN
# separately to BOTH plan and apply processes (including saved-plan applies).
# It is read only at runtime and never stored in Terraform plan/state or sent
# to Zerops. Do not embed credentials in the URL. Existing git.auth_token wins
# when explicitly supplied, but unlike the environment token it IS stored in state.
# Server mode ignores ZEROPS_GIT_TOKEN and only supports public repositories.
# Server mode only accepts public branches, requires repository zerops.yml,
# disallows auth_token and build=false, and builds HEAD at build time rather
# than pinning the planned branch-head commit. Inline YAML must match the repo.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `service_id` (String) Target runtime service ID.
- `zerops_yaml` (String, Sensitive) Raw deployment YAML, at most 50 KiB; may contain secrets.

### Optional

- `archive_path` (String) Local tar.gz archive; exactly one source is required.
- `build` (Boolean) Build before deploy; false uploads a ready-to-run archive.
- `git` (Attributes) Git source; provider mode fetches the exact planned commit and supports runtime-only ZEROPS_GIT_TOKEN when auth_token is absent. Supply that environment variable separately during plan and apply. Server mode supports public branches only and ignores the environment token. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--git))
- `setup` (String) YAML setup name; defaults to the target service hostname.
- `source_dir` (String) Local source directory, deterministically archived excluding .git directories.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) Operation timeouts. One timeout covers lock acquisition, API requests, queued work and readiness polling. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `triggers` (Map of String) Nonsecret replacement triggers.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether this invocation is the current active service release.
- `git_commit` (String) Resolved planned Git commit; server mode does not prove this is the built commit.
- `id` (String) App-version identifier.
- `process_id` (String) Build/deploy process identifier.
- `source_hash` (String) Plan-time archive SHA-256 or resolved Git commit. Content changes replace the invocation.
- `status` (String) Raw app-version status, or PURGED when history was removed.

<a id="nestedatt--git"></a>
### Nested Schema for `git`

Required:

- `ref` (String) Branch, tag or full commit SHA; server mode only accepts branches.
- `url` (String) HTTPS repository URL without embedded credentials.

Optional:

- `auth_token` (String, Sensitive) Provider-side Git authentication token, never passed to the API but stored in Terraform plan/state. Prefer runtime-only ZEROPS_GIT_TOKEN; an explicit auth_token takes precedence.
- `mode` (String) Fetch mode: provider (pinned archive) or server (public branch HEAD).


<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
